skill.summary: Fetch and parse news highlights from CCTV News Broadcast (Xinwen Lianbo) for a given date.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of CCTV News Fetcher skill.
- Fetches and parses news highlights from CCTV News Broadcast (Xinwen Lianbo) for any specified date.
- Supports date parsing from user input, including phrases like "yesterday" or "today".
- Executes a local script to retrieve news summaries and groups them by "Domestic" and "International" if possible.
- Implements security guardrails restricting command execution to the authorized script and disallowing external URL fetching.
